# Requirements

## Requirement 1: Readable build reporting

### Acceptance Criteria

1. Build starts with Rex artwork and version before checks, reports actual phases and completion duration; failures never print completion.
2. Chunk report distinguishes own gzip, static-import gzip and own-chunk budgets without changing measurements or suppressing warnings.
3. Artwork fits terminal width; plain redirected output has no ANSI sequences. Compiled CLI includes artwork without reading repository files.
